title: Install and Configure assistant-ui Library
description: Install the assistant-ui library and its peer dependencies, then configure the necessary providers and setup for integration with the existing Next.js application.
details: Install @assistant-ui/react and any required peer dependencies using npm/yarn. Review the assistant-ui documentation to understand the required providers and configuration. Set up the necessary context providers in the app layout or dashboard page as needed. Ensure compatibility with the existing shadcn/ui theme and Tailwind CSS configuration. Configure any required environment variables or configuration files for the assistant-ui integration.
test_strategy: Verify successful installation by checking package.json and node_modules. Test that the application builds without errors after installation. Create a minimal test component to ensure assistant-ui components render correctly within the existing UI framework.

title: Create Chat Interface Component
description: Develop a new client-side chat interface component using assistant-ui hooks and components that will handle user input, display AI responses, and manage chat state.
details: Create components/dashboard/chat-interface.tsx as a client component ('use client'). Implement the chat UI using assistant-ui's Thread, Composer, and Message components. Configure the component to handle user input, display conversation history, and show loading/error states. Integrate with the existing shadcn/ui design system for consistent styling. Implement proper TypeScript types for chat messages and state management. Add responsive design considerations for different screen sizes.
test_strategy: Unit test the component's rendering and state management. Test user input handling and message display functionality. Verify proper styling integration with shadcn/ui components. Test responsive behavior across different viewport sizes.

title: Integrate Chat API Connection
description: Connect the chat interface component to the existing /api/chat endpoint, implementing proper request/response handling and streaming support.
details: Configure the assistant-ui component to send POST requests to /api/chat endpoint. Implement proper error handling for API failures and network issues. Set up streaming response handling if the backend supports it, or implement standard request/response pattern. Add loading states during API calls and proper error messaging for users. Ensure proper serialization of chat messages and responses. Implement retry logic for failed requests with exponential backoff.
test_strategy: Mock the /api/chat endpoint for frontend testing. Test successful message sending and response handling. Test error scenarios including network failures and API errors. Verify loading states and user feedback during API calls. Test with actual backend integration once available.

title: Integrate Chat Interface into Dashboard
description: Embed the chat interface component into the main dashboard page and ensure proper layout, authentication, and user experience integration.
details: Import and render the ChatInterface component in app/dashboard/page.tsx. Ensure the component is properly positioned within the existing dashboard layout alongside other components like calendar view and metrics. Verify that the chat interface is only accessible to authenticated users through the existing auth system. Implement proper error boundaries around the chat component. Add any necessary loading states for the dashboard page. Ensure the chat interface doesn't interfere with other dashboard functionality and maintains good UX flow.
test_strategy: Test the complete dashboard page with the integrated chat interface. Verify authentication requirements are enforced. Test the layout and positioning across different screen sizes. Perform end-to-end testing of the complete user flow: login, navigate to dashboard, use chat interface. Test error boundaries and graceful degradation if chat component fails.
